planets.name: K2-116 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-116 with a 4.65-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: K2-116 b was found in 2017 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-116. Its orbit and size follow Dressing et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
